purpose: Portable scoped native evidence for three unique courier contracts, damaged-condition payment, a complete walking art route, original-car recovery, H1/H2/H3 human-impact fines, frozen H3 map/save reset, road police pursuit and a funded H3 capture. This is a separate ordinary-input run on the unchanged d58 Core-bus-lanes ROM.

warnings.message: Passing args to a child process with shell option true can lead to security vulnerabilities, as the arguments are not escaped, only concatenated.

inspection.method: 137 completed public held-button intervals from a fresh clean boot, genuine in-game four-button resets, read-only WRAM/OAM and authenticated source debug. No memory writes, injected progression, restored emulator checkpoint, native rebuild, browser or physical-device action.
inspection.labelMeaning: Original labels retain inspection intent, not necessarily success or exact event time. Native result/HUD images and actual raw bytes determine observed outcomes; frame labels such as files-result1776 do not replace its mode0 state.
inspection.countMeaning: The steps array retains all 137 completed public input intervals. The authenticated journal subdivides them into 312 step actions and 119 button changes, with 315 frame events. Read-only inspections do not advance emulation.
inspection.pngCountMeaning: 237 public step sample references include 186 distinct PNG byte hashes. The closed archive contains 246 PNG files including extra archive sampling; the portable steps do not invent per-frame images.
inspection.pngHashVerification: Every referenced archived PNG exists; file SHA-256 and independently decoded RGBA SHA-256 match retained native tool metadata. Images at 1920/4372/6402/8758 were visually reviewed.
inspection.peoplePositionMeaning: Route/stun/phase/lag/recover and route anchors are actual native bytes. sourceDerivedU/V apply the unchanged triangle phase expression and are not separate human actor reads. Stun observations are sampled remaining seconds, not exact impact timestamps.

inspection.oamPeakMeaning: Peak 4 / limit 10 is the tool-reported full hardware scanline summary. The returned visible-filtered objects alone do not reconstruct all hardware OAM.

scope: Market Start at frame 572 pays 86 + 23 = 109, cash 30 to 139 and done 1. Distillery Files at 1920 finishes condition 92 with 112 seconds left: base 102, condition pay 93 and bonus 22 credit 115, cash 254 and done 2.

First Art Crate is carried by walking from the Union/Bay pickup to the AGO. Retained active snapshots and the complete input route stay on foot; the 4372 result is condition 100, base 119, 99 seconds left, bonus 19 and credit 138, cash 392/done 3/bitmap 07. This does not validate all fragile routes or reward balance.

Actual stopped parking at 2532 leaves the original car at 811.4375/720; successive foot snapshots and the art result retain that parked point. Ordinary walking back and A entry at 6216 restore the same original vehicle 0/car at that point.

A genuine image at 6402 shows HUMAN HIT and cash 372/H1. By 6432 actual state is cash 332/H2 and route 80/85 remaining stuns 6/5. By 6760 actual state is cash 272/H3, with route 68 remaining stun 4. The source 20/40/60 escalation totals 120; exact impact instruction timing is not claimed.

H3 MAP at 6860 to 7100 freezes the exact 58-byte game, 61-byte people and 24-byte fleet blocks for 240 native frames. The map closes, an explicit menu save occurs, and a genuine four-button reset restores its saved 573.0625 car coordinate, cash 272/H3/done 3/seconds 103/subsecond 8, distinct from later live 7216 v576.75.

Actual police cache at 8364 is 480/277.5. At 8742 it reaches 640/528 while the car at 674.875/533 keeps cash 272/H3/countdown 30. By 8758 the police at 655.5/528 and car at 669.125/533 produce POLICE STOP, fine 225, cash 47/H0, speed 0 and message 20. This is a funded H3 capture only.

Capture OAM at 8758 returns 10 visible objects, full tool scanline peak 4/10 and zero over-limit lines. At 8998 the police remains at 655.5/528 behind the stopped courier; this is not a native patrol-return pass. The genuine post-capture reset at 9418 retains cash 47/H0/done 3/seconds 125 with subsecond 0.

recording.reason: Scoped exact d58 ordinary play: three unique contracts0/2/1, condition92 scaled payment93+22=115, full-condition walking art119+19=138, original-car parking/re-entry, visible human impacts H1/H2/H3 with cash392->372->332->272,240-frame H3 game/pedestrian/fleet map freeze, genuine saved-H3 reset, live road police approach and funded H3capture272->47/heatclear/vehicle stop, sampled OAM and postcapture reset retains47/done3. No native H1/H2 funded capture, escape/all-paid-mode/crowded/fullcampaign/twohumanhours/hardware acceptance; parked patrol waits behind stopped courier, not claimed as a return pass.

historicalComparison.scope: This separate d58 run adds only its own three-job/damaged-payment/human-fine/map/reset/pursuit/funded-H3-capture samples. Historical Queen 5ae4 and thirteen-job/Island 7b2 evidence remains pinned to its original ROM/runtime; broader branches cannot inherit this outcome.

limitations: H1/H2 impact fines are observed; funded H1/H2 police capture is not. H3 pursuit/capture does not establish escape, cooling/return success, all paid-ride suppression modes, higher-heat fine branches across scenes or crowd pacing.

Post-capture police is sampled stationary behind the stopped courier, so no native patrol return is claimed. H1 image 6402 and later H2/H3 state reads are observation boundaries, not inferred exact impact timestamps. The route/counter fields do not replace a full per-frame actor/contact trace.

Three unique contracts and one damaged payout plus walking art do not establish all 96 contracts, complete Old Toronto/fuller Islands, complete vehicle/reward/deadline balance, two measured enjoyable human hours or handheld steering feedback.

Native older-save imports, physical cold boot/cartridge/SRAM persistence, stream/flash/manual hardware, browser recovery and human audio/handling review remain separate pending gates. Historical Queen and Island campaign checks retain their original identities.

Linked 1,097-byte reserve is not deepest-stack measurement. Sampled OAM peak 4 is not all-city sprite capacity or FPS/CPU-latency acceptance. Accurate world-clock elapsed does not imply every bounded motion substep executes.
Portable relative paths and checksums are evidence locators, not publicly downloadable ROMs/images/saves. No binary image, SRAM save, activation state or host absolute path is embedded.
